dependencies.name: Platform C runtime and OS
dependencies.role: Allocation, files, process entry, clocks, entropy and dynamic loading. Native-managed values and GC remain TypeRB implementations.
dependencies.configuration: Darwin: libSystem. Linux: libc, libm and target-specific system linkage. Supplied by the target system; no universal library version is claimed.
dependencies.next: Inspect actual executable imports and deployment baseline for each qualified target.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Preserve ownership, errno/error mapping and cleanup at the typed boundary.

dependencies.name: OS time-zone database
dependencies.role: Named time zones use system zone data.
dependencies.configuration: System-provided TZif data, read by the owned time adapter; version follows the installed OS data.
dependencies.next: Record the data source and version when qualifying a distributable image.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Compare zone names, transitions and error behavior using recorded OS tzdata.

dependencies.name: Unicode tables
dependencies.role: Identifier classification and simple case mapping.
dependencies.configuration: Generated tables are compiled into Native; case mapping follows the pinned reference Unicode 17.0.0 contract. No ICU runtime dependency.
dependencies.next: Move generation to fixed, hashed UCD 17.0 input files; retain Go as exhaustive comparison. Current generators still invoke Go; this decision does not claim that dependency is removed.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Reference Unicode 17.0 simple case and identifier behavior; exhaustive comparison remains required.

dependencies.name: libuv
dependencies.role: TCP, address resolution, timers, signals and event delivery for Web.serve.
dependencies.configuration: Selectively static for verified network MIR; absent from non-network apps and the compiler. LP64 ABI assertions; foreign callbacks own raw buffers only. Embedded source/archive identity, MIT and bundled notices. No runtime library-directory override.
dependencies.next: Publish qualified immutable four-host artifacts and assign advisory/update ownership and rebuild deadlines before supported release distribution. Archive qualification does not establish the missing darwin-amd64 compiler profile.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Single mutator; callbacks return to the loop; preserve timeouts, shutdown and resource cleanup.

dependencies.name: llhttp
dependencies.role: HTTP/1 request framing and strict parsing for Web.serve.
dependencies.configuration: Generated C sources, selectively static with pinned callback/struct ABI and embedded archive identity; no Node.js or runtime library-directory requirement. Chunked/Content-Length precedence follows the pinned Go server; other leniency is disabled. MIT.
dependencies.next: Publish the commit/hash-pinned source mirror and immutable per-host archives after release update ownership is assigned; CI bundles are finite-retention qualification evidence. Preserve strict framing and cleanup checks on each target.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: HTTP/1 framing and malformed-input boundaries; retain the reviewed framing discrepancy in #1239.

dependencies.name: QBE
dependencies.role: Lower verified Native output to target assembly.
dependencies.configuration: Pinned upstream source plus five reviewed repository patches. Build QBE itself with explicit -O2 CFLAGS, recorded in its receipt, without fast-math or host-specific ISA flags. QBE is absent from running applications. ARM64 contraction also covers local division/square-root-fed products, retaining short reduction and product-observation guards.
dependencies.next: Verify the manifest, source and patch hashes, all target profiles and ordinary fixed points.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Qualify emitted machine behavior and exact backend identity on all release hosts.

dependencies.name: Platform C compiler, linker and SDK
dependencies.role: Assemble/link Native output and compile external library sources and ABI probes.
dependencies.configuration: Explicit tool paths. Darwin system toolchain; Linux target linker/libm policy. Versions belong in build receipts.
dependencies.next: Record tool versions, target SDK and actual linked dependencies for release artifacts.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Record compiler/linker/SDK baseline, ABI and actual executable imports.

dependencies.name: Previous Native compiler seed
dependencies.role: Start ordinary self-hosting without invoking the Go reference compiler.
dependencies.configuration: Immutable pinned seed and checksums; per-target provenance is distinct from subsequent source qualification.
dependencies.next: Verify immutable assets and preserve the ordinary multi-generation fixed-point chain.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Keep immutable seeds, ordinary fixed points and separate recovery evidence.

dependencies.name: Git command
dependencies.role: Resolve and fetch Git-backed package sources.
dependencies.configuration: External executable used by package tooling; an application that does not invoke package tooling does not require Git.
dependencies.next: Retain source validation, offline/frozen contracts and exact locked revisions.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Preserve lock/source identity and offline/frozen behavior; do not replace Git protocol semantics.

dependencies.name: Shell, make, Perl, curl and archive utilities
dependencies.role: Checkout bootstrap, verified downloads and toolchain setup.
dependencies.configuration: Setup commands only. Perl configures the pinned OpenSSL source build; prebuilt crypto archives do not require Perl at runtime. The curl executable is distinct from a future application dependency on libcurl.
dependencies.next: Keep download identities, temporary cleanup and bounded reusable caches.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Keep source hashes, archive extraction and tool provenance reproducible.

dependencies.name: Python and CMake
dependencies.role: Dependency builder, generated data and validation orchestration.
dependencies.configuration: CMake builds libuv; Python verifies source/archive identities, bounded installations and ABI inputs. Prebuilt application builds do not require CMake; neither tool is needed by a compiled server.
dependencies.next: Retain builder/tool versions and supported runner prerequisites in artifact receipts.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Producer/validation tools; prebuilt immutable dependency archives should avoid requiring CMake for application users.

dependencies.name: Go reference compiler and Node.js
dependencies.role: Reference conformance/recovery and documentation/tooling checks.
dependencies.configuration: Separate from the ordinary Native semantic build chain; no Go or Node application runtime fallback.
dependencies.next: Keep reference pins and recovery provenance distinct from ordinary Native builds.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Record exact reference revision and toolchains; source tests do not qualify Native artifacts.

dependencies.name: libcurl
dependencies.role: HTTP/HTTPS retrieval for OIDC discovery and JWKS.
dependencies.configuration: curl 8.23.0, curl license, fixed commit/archive; selectively static HTTP/HTTPS with the threaded DNS resolver, one pinned OpenSSL stack and zlib. TypeRB owns proxy/redirect/deadline policy. HTTP/2, IDN libraries and other optional protocols are disabled. Build-time installation beside QBE or TRBN_OIDC_LIB_DIR; no runtime loader.
dependencies.next: Complete transport edge qualification and immutable four-host artifacts under the owning tasks. Keep general HTTP clients and server TLS separate; qualify any added protocol/backend before changing the inventory.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: OIDC discovery/JWKS: total 5-second timeout, bounded response, HTTP/HTTPS, redirects, environment proxies and cache behavior from the pinned reference.

dependencies.name: OpenSSL: libssl / libcrypto
dependencies.role: Static libcrypto for digest/HMAC/comparison and RS256; compatible static libssl for OIDC HTTPS.
dependencies.configuration: OpenSSL 3.5.9 LTS, Apache-2.0, pinned commit/archive. Static crypto/TLS with upstream assembly; no shared libraries, modules, DSO, engines, legacy provider or implicit configuration. Explicit NO_LOAD_CONFIG initialization. Full CLI links libcrypto for REPL; OIDC consumers link matching libssl/libcurl to that same archive. Core compiler and lockfile hashing remain independent. Shared DB profiles remain unimplemented. Builder isolates ambient search flags and audits the actual libcurl translation unit for exclusively qualified OpenSSL headers.
dependencies.next: Qualify immutable four-host release artifacts and update ownership under #1257. Implement the single shared TLS stack for dynamic DB clients separately; never combine this static profile with a second dynamically loaded OpenSSL.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: TLS, RSA signature verification and hashes use one qualified stack per process; connection-specific CA/verification settings remain explicit.

dependencies.name: SQLite C API
dependencies.role: SQLite storage engine behind typed ORM values and transactions.
dependencies.configuration: Selected amalgamation with selective static linking, not introduced. Initial comparison target SQLite 3.53.2 from reference modernc.org/sqlite v1.53.0; verify exact version and observable compile options before pinning.
dependencies.next: Qualify the version/options with the current reference, threading, transaction lifetimes and four-host binaries; do not silently use the system SQLite.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Match SQLite version and observable options, values, transactions and errors against the reference modernc driver.

dependencies.name: libpq
dependencies.role: PostgreSQL connection, authentication and protocol implementation.
dependencies.configuration: First evaluation candidate for required PostgreSQL parity, not introduced. Use the same qualified OpenSSL build as other in-process TLS consumers.
dependencies.next: Resolve and qualify driver scope under the complete release contract; compare libpq before considering an owned wire client (SCRAM includes HMAC/PBKDF2, normalization and channel binding).
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Retain reference PostgreSQL behavior; compare authentication, transactions, cancellation and TLS. No PostgreSQL release deferral is approved.

dependencies.name: MariaDB Connector/C
dependencies.role: Evaluate a maintained C client for MySQL and MariaDB.
dependencies.configuration: Provisional selected client, not introduced. Prefer LGPLv2.1 dynamic library delivery with the same bundled shared OpenSSL used by all TLS/crypto consumers in MySQL applications.
dependencies.next: At M6 qualify normalized DSN/auth/TLS against Go, license/redistribution and loader behavior, then compare an owned wire client only with complete socket/TLS foundations and measured cost evidence.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Compare normalized DSN, authentication, TLS and value/error behavior with go-sql-driver/mysql. allowPublicKeyRetrieval is not a retained Go driver option.

dependencies.name: libdeflate (gzip)
dependencies.role: Whole-buffer gzip for the pinned Web compression middleware.
dependencies.configuration: libdeflate 1.26, MIT, selectively static for verified compression MIR. Default level (-1); gzip only, no decompression/zlib wrappers/tools. Embedded source/archive identity and notice. Importing the compression package selects it; the compiler has no libdeflate dependency. Build-time installation beside QBE or TRBN_COMPRESSION_LIB_DIR; no runtime loader.
dependencies.next: Qualify immutable four-host release artifacts and update ownership under #1257. Retain the measured small-body CPU/size costs against zlib; revisit with application evidence or a streaming contract.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Whole-buffer default-level gzip; compare decoded bytes, negotiated response metadata and errors, not identical compressed bytes.

dependencies.name: zlib (OIDC gzip decoding)
dependencies.role: Incremental bounded gzip decoding for OIDC discovery/JWKS responses.
dependencies.configuration: zlib 1.3.2, Zlib license, pinned commit/archive; selectively static with the OIDC profile. TypeRB bounds decompressed bytes, checks completion and owns each inflate state. Existing libdeflate response encoding is unchanged.
dependencies.next: Qualify immutable artifacts with the OIDC stack; preserve decompressed bounds and malformed-stream cleanup on updates.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Go HTTP transport advertises gzip and decodes only gzip; deflate/unknown encodings stay opaque. Enforce the 1 MiB bound on decoded bytes.

dependencies.name: OS CA store or CA bundle
dependencies.role: Trust anchors for authenticated TLS connections.
dependencies.configuration: OIDC trust adapter: macOS platform verification by default through Security.framework; nonempty SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR selects disk roots. Linux probes the reference bundle/directory paths with those overrides. No default Mozilla bundle or OpenSSL compiled CA paths.
dependencies.next: Retain explicit-CA file/directory and hostname-negative coverage on each supported host. Corporate/MDM trust and reference toolchain/GODEBUG variations require environment-specific qualification; shared DB trust remains separate.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Record Go toolchain, generated go.mod go line, GODEBUG and SSL_CERT_FILE/SSL_CERT_DIR when comparing trust behavior.

dependencies.name: Digest / HMAC provider
dependencies.role: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256/512, HMAC and constant-time comparison.
dependencies.configuration: Verified standard declarations select pinned OpenSSL 3.5.9 libcrypto statically. Full CLI is a consumer for retained REPL; core and lockfile SHA-256 stay independent. Unrelated applications need no crypto archives. Fixed-length comparison uses CRYPTO_memcmp; unequal lengths return false.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: 82 frozen digest, RFC 4231 HMAC, binary/padding/empty/long-key and comparison observations across check, build, run and retained REPL at TYPE_RB_REVISION. Constant-time provider code review is separate from known-answer tests.
dependencies.next: Retain the three-pair Darwin arm64 diagnostic: SHA-256 executable increment 3,217,616 bytes, below the prospective 4 MiB guardrail. Build/startup samples are local observations, not universal latency guarantees. Qualify other host artifacts; compare HACL* or AWS-LC if later application budgets miss. Owned primitives require measured benefit and side-channel review.

dependencies.name: sqldef command tools
dependencies.role: sqlite3def / psqldef / mysqldef for database schema workflows.
dependencies.configuration: Required external tool family for Native cli.db parity, not integrated. Qualify and pin tool identity separately from database C clients.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Preserve executable selection, argv, schema input/output, exit handling and missing-tool diagnostics.
dependencies.next: Qualify exact CLI versions, availability and license/distribution; these are not implicitly bundled runtime libraries.

dependencies.name: Pinned Go site generator and highlighter
dependencies.role: Keep canonical documentation publishing through the Native repository transition.
dependencies.configuration: Selected documentation-only mode at v0.5 cutover. Build trb-site from a fixed Go implementation source with recorded Go/module identities; feed current canonical docs and pinned Node/Shiki highlighting. No application runtime or hosted WASM requirement.
dependencies.referenceBehavior: Keep updated installation, CLI differences, navigation, versions and browser-unavailable pages. Go local play/tour remains required; Native local execution and hosted Run/Transpile/Format have scoped approved deferrals.
dependencies.next: Rehearse source/tool hashes and canonical docs ownership in #1168; restore local Native play/tour before evaluating Native TS browser output.
